_comment: ApplyPilot target employers (single-user). Copy this file to config/targets.json and fill in REAL board identifiers. US roles only. NEVER guess a boardId: observe the exact request the employer's OWN careers page issues (open the careers page, watch the network tab for the greenhouse/lever/ashby/smartrecruiters/workable API call, and copy the board token/slug/account from it). `npm run discover` reads config/targets.json, seeds these employers, then scans them plus any exported job-alert emails. Supported vendors: greenhouse | lever | ashby | smartrecruiters | workable | workday. Workable postings are surfaced for manual apply; Workday postings support an EXPERIMENTAL multi-step fill (review every page). For workday, boardId is the FULL careers board URL (https://<tenant>.wdN.myworkdayjobs.com/<site>), not a bare slug.
